target_customer: Households first (preorder), later cities and public health agencies for mosquito control
problem: Mosquito control is costly and chemical heavy while mosquito borne disease kills about a million people a year (company claim).
business_model: Hardware sales of micro-drones plus base station; $100 refundable reservation for early access
product_category: Autonomous micro-drone hardware for pest control

founders.name: Alex Toussaint
founders.background_notes: YC bio says he built an early in-air phased array sonar at 18.

founders.name: Clovis Piedallu
founders.background_notes: Coverage cites drone flight control experience.

investors: Manifund donors (YC page cites Scott Alexander and Vitalik Buterin)

competitors.name: Photonic Fence (Intellectual Ventures)
competitors.what: Laser perimeter system to shoot mosquitoes; a drone variant was only suggested
competitors.traction_then: Lab and limited field test only

competitors.name: Photon Matrix
competitors.what: LiDAR based mosquito killing laser crowdfunded in 2025

technical_complexity.rationale: Acoustic sensing of insects with phased array sonar, tiny drone control and short flight times; drones were so far tested in simulation and on benches.

defensibility.rationale: Hard hardware and DSP know-how, but few direct rivals have invested in this approach, so defensibility is untested.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No well resourced player found building the same wedge.

market_need_then: Large public health burden (malaria, dengue, West Nile) and growing resistance to chemicals; a first mosquito detection with an ultrasonic phased array drew Hackaday coverage in March 2025. Consumer drone demand is unproven.

identity.logo: Lowercase wordmark shown over three drone images in black, red and yellow, per a coverage snippet
identity.voice_and_tone: Bold mission statement (eradicate mosquitoes) with engineer founder storytelling.

branding.brand_signature: The micro-drone first air-to-air kill video (July 2026)
branding.community_and_virality: Wide press pickup: Gizmodo, TechRadar, PopSci, DroneXL, The Hustle, Interesting Engineering; viral demo videos.

brand_strength.rationale: Striking concept earned broad press and preorders, but the name origin is unknown and the product is unproven.

outcome_analysis: Tornyol is active with seven people and a viral concept that drew wide press and preorders. On July 14, 2026 its drone achieved a first air-to-air kill of a moth in a controlled test, not a mosquito in the wild. Technical risk stays high and funding is small, so scaling is unproven.
notes: Founded year not stated by the YC page; StartupHub says 2025 (unverified). The $500K seed is from The Hustle and CB Insights; StartupHub says $4M total, unverified and not used. The $28K grant is from the YC page citing a Manifund project; date unknown. Company site fetch was blocked by a rate-limited safety check. Competitor entries are sparse because no dated drone rival existed at the batch.
